desert/crossing: A four-vehicle column heading south halts at the dry wadi crossing; two technicals wait under the trees, and an enemy position holds the edge of the rocky plateau. The house by the salt flat is civilian.
desert/dunes: Night, over the dunes: a supply column climbing north halts short of the wadi, and a missile launcher hides at the edge of the sand, guarded by an armoured vehicle. The house to the north is civilian.
desert/wadi_tic: A friendly patrol (two armoured vehicles and infantry) crossed the dry wadi and was ambushed from the rocky plateau to the west: fighters, a technical with a 12.7 mm gun, a twin 23 mm gun on the edge, a MANPADS team, and more fighters among the trees on the east bank. Hunter marks the targets with red smoke. The house to the north-east is civilian.
desert/escort: A friendly supply column (two armoured vehicles, a truck and a fuel tanker) heads south across the dry wadi to the end of the road. Intelligence expects ambushes at the crossing and the dune edge. Clear the way: it halts under fire and moves on once the guns that can reach it fall silent. The mission ends when it arrives.
port/port: A weapons shipment is being unloaded on the quay: technicals, a truck and a fuel tanker among the containers, fighters on the quay, the arms store among the quay warehouses, and a column leaving south that halts at the camp junction. The ships and the other warehouses are civilian: do not hit them.
port/camp: Night: a fortified camp south of the port, with a missile launcher and technicals on the parade ground, fighters among the barracks, an armoured vehicle at the gate, and a supply column coming up from the south to the junction. Also targets: the two fuel tanks and the command building north of the camp. The thermal sees the warmth between the buildings.
port/quay_tic: A friendly force has entered the warehouse yard and is taking fire from the quay to its west: fighters among the containers, a technical with a 12.7 mm gun, a twin 23 mm gun on the quay road, and a MANPADS team. The ships, warehouses and buildings are all civilian: precision above all.
port/raid: Night: a friendly force is storming the camp through its east gate and meeting resistance: an armoured vehicle with a machine gun at the gate, technicals and a twin 23 mm gun inside the camp, fighters among the barracks, and a MANPADS team. Our troops flash infrared: the thermal sees them. The command building and the two fuel tanks are targets.
port/escort: A friendly column (two armoured vehicles and a truck) climbs north from the south to the warehouse yard, on a road between the wadi and the rocks. Ambushes are expected on both sides. It halts under fire and moves on once the guns that can reach it fall silent; the mission ends when it arrives.
theater/th_tic: From the base: a friendly patrol is under fire in the valley to the north, about 1.5 km away. Lift off, head north and work with Hunter. Return to the base (BASE) to rearm.
theater/th_cross: From the base: A four-vehicle column heading south halts at the dry wadi crossing; two technicals wait under the trees, and an enemy position holds the edge of the rocky plateau. The house by the salt flat is civilian.
theater/th_port: From the base south to the coast: A weapons shipment is being unloaded on the quay: technicals, a truck and a fuel tanker among the containers, fighters on the quay, the arms store among the quay warehouses, and a column leaving south that halts at the camp junction. The ships and the other warehouses are civilian: do not hit them.
theater/th_camp: From the base, by night: a fortified camp south of the port, with a missile launcher and technicals on the parade ground, fighters among the barracks, an armoured vehicle at the gate, and a supply column coming up from the south to the junction. Also targets: the two fuel tanks and the command building north of the camp. The thermal sees the warmth between the buildings.
theater/th_wadi: From the base, west: A friendly patrol (two armoured vehicles and infantry) crossed the dry wadi and was ambushed from the rocky plateau to the west: fighters, a technical with a 12.7 mm gun, a twin 23 mm gun on the edge, a MANPADS team, and more fighters among the trees on the east bank. Hunter marks the targets with red smoke. The house to the north-east is civilian.
theater/th_quay: From the base, south: A friendly force has entered the warehouse yard and is taking fire from the quay to its west: fighters among the containers, a technical with a 12.7 mm gun, a twin 23 mm gun on the quay road, and a MANPADS team. The ships, warehouses and buildings are all civilian: precision above all.
theater/th_raid: From the base, by night: a friendly force is storming the camp through its east gate and meeting resistance: an armoured vehicle with a machine gun at the gate, technicals and a twin 23 mm gun inside the camp, fighters among the barracks, and a MANPADS team. Our troops flash infrared: the thermal sees them. The command building and the two fuel tanks are targets.
theater/th_escort: From the base: a friendly supply column (two armoured vehicles, a truck and a fuel tanker) comes down from the high desert past the base, the wadi crossing and the port warehouses to the camp junction, about 1.5 km. Ambushes are expected at the crossing, at the dune edge, and between the wadi and the rocks near the port. It halts under fire and moves on once the guns that can reach it fall silent; return to the base to rearm if you need to. The mission ends when it arrives.
theater/th_def: An attack on the base: fighters and a technical with a 12.7 mm gun are closing on the west fence, with a twin 23 mm gun and a MANPADS team behind them, and more technicals are coming down the main road to the base junction. The guards hold the gate and the fence. Lift off from the pad at once. The base buildings are ours: do not hit them.
theater/th_op: An operation in three phases: (1) support the patrol in the valley to the north, (2) then the patrol at the wadi crossing in the desert, (3) then secure the port quay to the south. Each tasking comes by radio once the one before is decided. Rearm at the base between phases (BASE); the operation ends when you land on the pad.
theater/th_armor: From the base, west then north: an armoured column is coming south down the valley: two T-72 tanks, two BTR-80s and two Ural ammunition trucks. A 23 mm gun position and a machine-gun trench cover the crossing, and a Grad launcher behind the plateau shells the area. Only the Hellfire touches the tank; the trucks are easier: stop the column before it reaches the port.
theater/th_sea: From the base to the coast, south-west: a dhow is smuggling weapons from the port out to the open sea, escorted by a fast attack craft with a 12.7 mm gun, while a rocket boat waits by the reef to the north. Civilian fishing boats are around them: do not hit them. The dhow is slow and the Hellfire runs it down, the fast craft too. If the dhow reaches open water it is lost, and anything exploding near them makes them run.
theater/th_land: From the base to the coast, west: an enemy landing craft is heading in from the open sea to the sandy bay north of the port, carrying two technicals and their crews, escorted by a patrol boat with a 23 mm gun. Stop it before the beach; if they land, hit them on the sand before they move. A rocket boat shells the port from the reef, and civilian fishing boats are close by.
theater/j_train: Your first sortie in the back seat. The pilot flies and talks you through it on the intercom, a step at a time: the pod, tracking, identification, arming, a laser bomb on an old truck on the range, then the Maverick on a disabled tank. The button you need lights up in the cockpit.
theater/j_strike: A planned strike on five fixed targets by their coordinates: the arms store in the quay yard (its buildings are military), the large ammunition depot north of the port (it needs a heavy bomb), and the two fuel tanks and the command building in the camp. JDAMs from the orbit on each coordinate. The ships, the other warehouses and the port buildings are civilian: precision above all.
theater/j_cas: A friendly patrol in the dry wadi is under fire from an ambush on the rocky plateau to the west. Hunter talks you on and marks with red smoke, and he will not clear a 500 lb bomb on an enemy closer than 300 m to our troops (500 m for the heavy one): the close ones are for the Maverick. A MANPADS team is in the ambush; the orbit is above its reach.
theater/j_convoy: An enemy column of six vehicles is coming south down the valley toward the port, halting briefly at the wadi crossing. If it reaches the port it mixes with the civilians and is lost. The target is moving: the laser bomb follows it while your pod holds it, the Maverick takes the fastest, and the JDAM cannot hit what moves.
theater/j_tst: Armed reconnaissance over the desert: an enemy checkpoint at the crossing. Intelligence expects a missile launcher hidden in the valley to the north to come out to fire: if it appears you have three minutes before it launches and goes back into hiding. It has priority.
theater/j_night: Night: a friendly force waits east of the camp to storm it after your strike. Targets: the missile launcher, the armoured vehicle at the gate, the technicals, the two fuel tanks and the command building. A 23 mm gun and a MANPADS team are in the camp: do not go below 15,000 ft. The thermal sees the warmth between the buildings, and our troops flash infrared.
theater/j_sea: A dhow is smuggling weapons from the port out to the open sea, escorted by a fast attack craft with a 12.7 mm gun, while a rocket boat waits by the reef to the north. Civilian fishing boats are around them: do not hit them. The dhow is slow and the laser bomb follows it; the Maverick is for the fast craft. If the dhow reaches open water it is lost, and anything exploding near them makes them run.
theater/j_armor: An armoured column is coming south down the valley: two T-72 tanks, two BTR-80s and two Ural ammunition trucks. A 23 mm gun position and a machine-gun trench cover the crossing, and a Grad launcher behind the plateau shells the area. Only a bomb or the Maverick touches the tank; the trucks are easier: stop the column before it reaches the port. With it is an SA-8 air defence on the plateau east of the road, its 10 km covering the whole valley: from your orbit you are inside it now. Widen the orbit (RAD 10) or climb to 25,000 ft to get out of it, and hit it with the Maverick from there before the column. If it fires: chaff and break.
theater/j_land: An enemy landing craft is heading in from the open sea to the sandy bay north of the port, carrying two technicals and their crews, escorted by a patrol boat with a 23 mm gun. Stop it before the beach; if they land, hit them on the sand before they move. A rocket boat shells the port from the reef, and civilian fishing boats are close by.
theater/j_op: An operation in three phases, each by radio: (1) strike the arms store on the quay and the supply tanker, (2) support the patrol at the wadi crossing, (3) a time-sensitive target. The next comes once the one before is decided, and the ammunition is not replenished: spread it.
